title: Cohomology boundary as composition with an extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme; use Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and the locally-free identification [lem-sc-ext-locally-free]. Let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and let $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$ be its Yoneda extension class. Under the canonical identification $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)=H^1(X,\mathcal A)$, the connecting map $\partial_H:H^0(X,\mathcal C)=\operatorname{Hom}_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal C)\to H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ sends a section $s$ to the Yoneda composite $\delta\circ s$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0B3A (first cohomology and extensions: the extension class is the image of 1 under the boundary), with Derived Section Tag 06XP (long exact sequences of Ext and Yoneda composition)

proof.text: Identify a section $s\in H^0(X,\mathcal C)$ with the corresponding morphism $s:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal C$. By [lem-sc-p1-boundary-connecting-naturality] with $u=s$ and $t=1$, $\partial_H(s)=\partial_{s^*\mathcal B}(1)$.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A, functoriality of the boundary under pullback

proof.text: The pulled-back sequence $s^*\mathcal B$ ends in $\mathcal O_X$, so [lem-sc-p1-boundary-one-extension-class] identifies $\partial_{s^*\mathcal B}(1)$ with the Yoneda class of $s^*\mathcal B$.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A (boundary of 1 is the extension class)

proof.text: By [lem-sc-p1-pullback-extension-class], the Yoneda class of $s^*\mathcal B$ is $\delta\circ s$. Combining the three equalities gives $\partial_H(s)=\delta\circ s$.
